༄༅/ /sngags rgod lok+t+ri pā la'i las byang snying po'i don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// sngags rgod lok+t+ri pā la'i las byang snying po'i don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//
oṃ swasti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes phrin las ni// rig sngags grub pa drang srong chen po'i skur// yongs bzhengs gsang bdag dpa' bor gus btud nas// gang gi sgrub thabs phrin las 'dir gsal bya//

de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po la yo byad kyi bsham dang cho ga'i sngon 'gro gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ gnas khang mdzes par brgyan pa dam tshig gi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu khebs dang ldan pa'i khar/ rin po che'i snod du zhi ba'i dkar gtor zlum po dkar gsum mngar gsum shing thog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang*/ khro bo'i dmar gtor gtso 'khor brgyad pa sha khrag sogs kyis brgyan pa dang*/ chos skyong gter srung sogs kyi gtor ma rnams dang*/ sman phud/ rak+ta/ nyer spyod lnga sogs mchod rdzas dang*/ tshogs rdzas rol mo sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa la bdun las/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/

rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad drang srong zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ
zhes spyan drangs la/
hūm̐/ brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha// legs par byin rlabs mkha' 'gro ma// rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi//
lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/
hūm̐/ bdag gzhan gnyis med don bsgrub phyir// drang srong khro rgyal mchog bsgrubs nas// snying po bla med byang chub bar// gzhan don byed par sems bskyed do//
lan gsum/ gsum pa tshogs gsag ni/

bde gshegs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod cing sdig pa bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor// mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs// bla med mchog gi dam tshig rnams// bdag gis deng nas gzung bar bgyi// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/
bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ gtor ma bshams la/
raṃ yaṃ khaṃ
gis nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs/
stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par
bsam la/
oṃ āḥhūm̐
gis byin brlab/
sarba bigh+nān i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/
zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos la/

hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang zhing*// byang chub sgrub la bar gcod rnams// mchod sbyin bzang pos tshims byos la// myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// sprul pa'i khro tshogs mang po yis// rdul du brlag par gdon mi za//
drag sngags rol mo'i tsham rngam dang bcas pas bskrad/ lnga pa mtshams gcad pa ni/

hūm̐/ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i// mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin bsrung*// hūm̐/ steng yang rdo rje'i gur khang la// rdo rje'i thog dang ser chen 'beb// 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams rdo rjes gtams pa yi// rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces dang spro na phyag mtshan gzhan rnams kyi gur rim yang 'don bsgom bya chog cing*/ bsdu na mtshon cha thams cad rdo rje'i ngo bor shes dgos pa'i phyir gong du brjod pa nyid kyis kyang chog go /drug pa byin dbab pa ni/

hūm̐/ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gzugs sku 'jigs byed khro bo'i skur ston pa// drang srong zhe sdang rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes brtser dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dbang skur byin phob dngos grub stsol// ngo mtshar rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston// oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dzaḥ
zhes sngags kyi mthar/
dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā/
zhes dang*/
hūm̐ hūm̐
zhes pas byin dbab cing bsdu'o// bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlob pa ni/

bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas mchod rdzas kyi nyes skyon dang dngos 'dzin dri ma thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bhañdza 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su oṃ las phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan so so'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha' rab 'byams gang ba rnams su gyur
par bsam la/
oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/
de bzhin du/
pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐/
zhes dang*/ sman phud/

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ
lan bdun/ rak+ta la/

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod du raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du ra yig zhu ba las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa la khams gsum gyi rak+ta thams cad bsdus shing thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ
lan gsum/ gtor ma/

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor gzhong bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i mchod sdong 'dab ma stong ldan gyi snying por gtor rdzas oṃ las 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ
zhes lan gsum/ de dag ni sngon 'gro 'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bcu las/ dang po lha bskyed gnyis kyi dang po zhi bar bsgom pa ni/

rang lus tha mal dhū ti'i nang*// snying thad pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus// nyi zla'i gdan la a dkar po// de las 'od 'phros sdig sgrib sbyangs// rtsa gsum 'dus mdor pad+ma ni// dmar po 'dab ma bzhi steng du// a yig ri bong 'dzin pa'i mdog /'od 'phros lus ngag nad gdon sbyangs// skad cig bdag nyid drang srong ni// sku mdog sngo skya skem rid gzugs// smin ma ag tshom rgya mdor bslebs// ras dkar smad dkris stod g.yogs can// skyil krung tshul bzhugs gun+dhe bsnams// 'khor du drang srong 'bum gyis bskor// snying gar nyi ma'i gdan steng du// srog gi snying po hūm̐ mthing nag /traṃ du'i sngags kyis bskor bar
bsam//
oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dzaḥ
zhes gong bsnyen khri tsho gcig bzla bar gsungs shing*/ rgyun gyi phrin las kyi skabs 'dir yang brgya rtsa tsam re bzla'o// gnyis pa drag por gnas bsgyur ni/

rang nyid drang srong zhi ba ru// gsal ba 'od du zhu ba las// gser gyi tsakra rtsibs brgyad dbus// rang nyid skad cig khro bo ni// zhe sdang rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// dang po gnyis kyis tho ba dang*// ral gri 'bar ba rab tu gdengs// mtha' gnyis gnam lcags lag mthil la// sor mo lcags sdig mgo dgur phyar/ kham nag dbu skra gyen du brdzes// nyi zla'i gdan la brkyang bskum bgrad// shin tu khros shing mi sdug pa// rgyan med me dpung dbus na bzhugs// spyi bor drang srong dri med dang*// de steng rigs bdag pad 'byung bzhugs// thugs kar hrīḥlas gser 'khor ni// rtsibs brgyad dbus su pad nyi'i steng*// rang 'dra'i gsang bdag ye shes sems// thugs srog mchong gur phub 'dra ba// zur brgyad dbus su nyi steng hūm̐// mthing nag gsal 'tsher ting 'dzin sems// lce rtsa'i ma rkan a yig las// zla dkyil a dkar traṃ dus bskor// smra byed gnam lcags rdo rje ni// rtse dgu lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan/ khong gseng phyir gdengs ra dgu'i rtser// mchong bcag 'dra ba'i phaṭa dgu las// me yi tshwa tshwa shugs drag 'phro// rang gi gnas gsum oṃ dkar dang*// āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gsum gyis mtshan// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// rgya gar lho phyogs kun 'dus ri// nags tshal drwa ba'i pho brang nas// drang srong zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// sprin gtibs bzhin du byon par gyur//
ces pas gsal gdab bo// gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ mos gus gdung shugs drag pos snyan pa'i lha cha rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas

oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs ngos// yul ni rgya gar in+d+ra'i yul// ri bo kun 'dus rtse mo nas// nags tshal drwa ba'i klong dkyil na// rin chen sna lnga'i khri steng na// slob dpon drang srong dri med ni// drang srong 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sems can don la gshegs su gsol// sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs= byad ma zlog phyir gshegs= 'byung po 'dul phyir gshegs= rgyal bsen 'dul phyir gshegs= dgra bgegs 'dul phyir gshegs= pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ha la ha la hi li hi li he he dung dung dzaḥdzaḥ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog /
ces pas spyan drangs la/ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/
hūm̐/ bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// drang srong 'khor bcas byon pa legs// ji srid brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la gzigs// thugs rjes bdag la dbang bzhi skur//
ces dang*/
oṃ traṃ du tri na traṃ du dza dzaḥ
nyer gcig brjod pas
dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur
par bsam mo// bzhi pa phyag bya ba ni/
hūm̐/ slob dpon dri med 'khor bcas la// bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// sde brgyad dbang sdud dngos grub stsol// mthu rtsal dbang gi dngos grub stsol//
ces pas phyag bya/ lnga pa mchod pa la gnyis kyi phyi mchod ni/

oṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku /drang srong rgyal po rig sngags bdag /drag sngags bdag po mthu rtsal can// sde brgyad 'dul ba'i drag shul can/ khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// snang gsal sgron me 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa sel bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ khyed skur sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir// bdud rtsi'i khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sku rnams dbyings nas dag pa bzhin// sems can sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi ngad ldan spos mchog 'di// drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thugs rjes byin rlobs bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ bskal pa bzang po'i nas 'bru bzhin// zhal zas ro mchog brgya ldan 'di// drang srong khyod la 'bul lags na// thugs rje dang ni dam tshig dang*// gnyis med don gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra nai bid+ya āḥhūm̐/ ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs bzhin// sgra snyan rgyun rnams thams cad kun// drang srong khyed la 'bul lags na// thugs rje dang ni dam tshig dang*// gnyis med don gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/
/zhes gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod pa lngas mchod/ nang gi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag dang*// dug lnga sman sbyar bdud rtsi dang*/ khams gsum bsgral pa'i rak+ta dang*// 'dod yon rmad byung gtor ma rnams// dgyes skong dam rdzas nam mkha'i khams// yongs su gang ba 'di dag rnams// drang srong khro bo'i rgyal po che// zhe sdang rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag /'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā pū dza khā hi/
zhes nang gi mchod pa'i sa khong gzung ba tsam gyis chog par byed pa'am/ spro na rigs mthun gyi cho ga gzhan nas blangs kyang rung ngo*// drug pa bstod pa ni/

hūm̐/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa yi// drang srong chen po dri med ni// bag chags dri ma mi mnga'i phyir// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs// thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i phyir// zhal gcig phyag gnyis drang srong sku /'dod chags dug lnga spangs pa'i phyir// sku mdog sngo skya skem rid gzugs/ khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// dbu skra lcang lo gyen du 'khyil// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// zhal nas sde brgyad spu gri gsung*// sde brgyad gnod pa zlog pa'i phyir// phyag na gser gyi rdo rje bsnams// sprul pas kun la khyab pa'i phyir// 'khor du drang srong 'bum gyis bskor// sde brgyad dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// ri bo kun 'dus rtse la bzhugs// sangs rgyas sprul pa yin pa'i phyir// sku la na bza' ras gos gsol// sa bcu zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir// nags tshal drwa ba'i phug na bzhugs// tshe dang bsod nams spel ba'i phyir// shing tog sna tshogs zhal du gsol// sangs rgyas stong gi sprul pa'i sku /drang srong khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ khyed kyis bdag la dngos grub stsol// sde brgyad dbang du sdud pa'i phyir// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bdag la stsol//
ces dang*/ spro na khro bo'i bstod pa'ang bya/ bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/

hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// las ngan dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// bar gcod rgyal 'gong 'dul ba dang*// byad ma rbod gtong bzlog pa dang*// lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i phyir/ drang srong chen po rab khros shing*// nyon mongs dug gsum 'joms pa'i phyir// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs// zhe sdang dug lnga gzhom pa'i phyir// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs// mi dge bcu rnams 'dul ba'i phyir// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bzhengs// lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i phyir// drang srong 'khor bcas thams cad bzhengs// bar gcod log 'dren 'dul ba'i phyir// phyag mtshan thams cad mtshon char bzhengs// bzhengs shig drang srong chen po'i tshogs// 'dir byon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /phrin las bcol ba'i dus la bab// byad ma zlog pa'i dus la bab// rgyal 'gong 'dul ba'i dus la bab// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab// 1$0000270ces bskul pas lha tshogs thams cad drag po'i rnam rol du hab dir gyis bzhengs par 1$0000300
bsam mo// brgyad pa che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/

1$0000270rang gi lce rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu spros pas sde brgyad rnams kyi snying nas drangs te ngud mo'i sgra dang bcas pas rang dbang med par bkug pa mdun du 'dar phril gyis 'khod par 1$0000300
bsam/
1$0000270slar yang lce'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i rdo rje rgya gram re de rnams kyi spyi bor 1$0000300
1$0000270bzhag pas g.yo 'gul mi shes par 1$0000300
bsam la/
hūm̐/ nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab// nga ni gshin rje kun gyi yum// nga ni khams gsum kun gyi bdag /nga ni dbang phyug chen po ste// nga ni srog gcod kun gyi rje// nga ni srid pa kun gyi bdag /
rgyud kyis mtshon pa'i gter gzhung phal cher la 'di'o/

hūm̐/ nga ni srid pa kun gyi rje// nga ni skye 'gro kun gyi yab// nga ni srog gcod kun gyi bdag /thams cad kun gyi srog snying bdag /khyod kyi snying khrag nga la yod// nga yi las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs// nga ni skye 'gro kun gyi yab// nga ni snying khrag kun gyi bdag /khyod kyi snying khrag nga la yod// nga yi las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs//
zhes pas
1$0000270dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad kyi srog bdag gi dbang du gyur 1$0000300
par bsam mo// dgu pa dam brdar zhing dpang gsol ba ni/

hūm̐/ sangs rgyas thams cad gzu dang dpang*// dam chos rin chen gzu dang dpang*// dge 'dun 'dus pa gzu dang dpang*// dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang*// chos skyong srung ma gzu dang dpang*// rgyal 'gong chen po 'dul ba'i phyir// drang srong chen po dri med khyod// sku ni mi 'gyur brtan pa la// phyag mtshan 'khor lo sgyur bzhin du// dgra bgegs mgo la 'khor lo skor// rgyal 'gong mgo la 'khor lo skor// sde brgyad sro la 'khor lo skor// 'khor lo g.yas su skor tsa na// rgyal 'gong snying la 'khor lo rgyob// 'khor lo g.yon du skor tsa na// mo gdon snying la 'khor lo rgyob//
ces pas
1$0000270phyag mtshan gyi mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi sprin 'phros pas dregs pa thams cad bag 'khums te gnas par 1$0000300
bsam mo// bcu pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/
dwangs ma'i thugs srog yi ge hūm̐// shin tu gsal zhing 'bar ba
man ngag sems la shes pa'i gnad do/
dang*// lce rtsa'i ma rkan zla dkyil steng*// a yig dkar po traṃ dus bskor/
'dren pa dkyil gyi gnad do//
de steng lce ni gnam lcags kyi/ khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i// lte bar nyi steng hūm̐ mthing nag /drag sngags 'od zer phreng bas bskor/
gnas pa rtsa'i gnad do//
rwa dgu khong gseng phyir gdengs rtser// phaṭa dmar mchong bcag lta bu las// me yi tshwa tshwa drag tu 'phro/
gcod pa lce yi gnad do//

lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// srog yig snying gnas sde brgyad rnams// bkug pas 'dar zhing thal mo sbyar// phyag 'tshal ci gsung bka' nod cing// srog snying tshur drangs rdo rje yi// lte ba'i hūm̐ gi gdan du byas// zil mnan 'khor 'das kun bdag nga'o//
zhes don dran bzhin pas/

oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan/ sa ga pā sha nan/ nā ga du du nan/ ma maṃ ma maṃ/ tsir tsar tsir tsar/ baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu/ rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya/ ho ra ho ra/ tsi du sod tsi du sod/ shigs lhu ru gtubs/ ha la pa ti nan/ 'khor ba thul/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kā wā tsi brlag brlag /
ces rtsa sngags ci nus su bzla'o//

rdo rje'i rtse yi phaṭa rnams las// gnam lcags rdo rje me 'bar ba// mgar gyi tshwa tshwa ltar 'phros pa// bka' la 'khu zhing dam log pa'i// gnod byed rnams la phog pa yis// rtswa sbur me yis bsregs pa ltar// tshag sgra dang bcas rdul phran bzhin// rjes shul tsam yang med par gyur// oṃ lok+t+ri pā la nan rbad thums/ 'jig rten mgon po'i srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ sa ga pā sha nan rbad ling*/ sa bdag gi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ nā ga du du nan rbad phaṭa/ klu bdud kyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ ma maṃ ma maṃ rbad myogs/ ma mo'i srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ tsir tsar tsir tsar rbad rbud/ btsan gyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu rbad thums/ bdud kyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya rbad khos/ gza' bdud kyi srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/ ho ra ho ra rbad shag /rgyal po'i srog chod snying phyungs tsit+ta mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad/
ces drag sngags dang*/ thun sngags ni/

rgyal po'i srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ bsen mo'i srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ pe har gyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ gtsang thel gyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ gnod byed
bsam sbyor ngan pa'i/
kyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/
che ge mo

'i srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sde brgyad kyi srog la dung dung snying la shad shad/ tsi du sod tsi du sod rbad thibs/ shigs lhu ru gtubs rbad myogs/ ha la pa ti nan/ ga na pa ti rbad rmugs/ 'khor ba thul rbad choms/ gnod byed 'byung po'i kā wā tsi brlag brlag rbad hur/ dgra bgegs
che ge mo
